Keyboard Shortcuts

  • j/k or ↓/↑: Move to next/prev expandable line
  • h/l: Scroll left/right
  • Enter: Expand/collapse
  • Space: Scroll down
  • Esc: Clear selection

Function Call Folding

  • Click ▶ to fold/unfold; Shift+Click for recursive fold/unfold
  • On a phone, tap the left gutter to fold without scrolling to the function name
  • On a phone, Filter opens the query editor; More contains Tree guides and other Text tools
  • 1-9: Fold to depth N (hide calls deeper than N)
  • 0: Unfold all fold blocks
  • Folded blocks show summary: call count, total time, return value
  • Folded blocks are saved in browser storage

Compare Help

  • Filter function names with a case-insensitive regular expression.
  • Click a metric heading to sort; choose |Δ|, Δ, Δ%, current or base.
  • Turn off Changed only to include unchanged functions.
  • Load more appends rows; Export CSV includes all matching rows.
  • Measured durations include tracing overhead; subtraction is an estimate.
